name: de-drum
description: Local drum separation from audio using Demucs + MPS.

scripts.lint: node scripts/run.mjs -m ruff check src/ tests/ services/backend/
scripts.format: node scripts/run.mjs -m ruff format src/ tests/ services/backend/ && npx prettier --write .
scripts.docker:up: docker compose up -d gateway backend && echo '→ Gateway at http://localhost:3000'
scripts.docker:separate: docker compose run --rm de-drum python3 src/separate.py
scripts.docker:ui: docker compose --profile legacy up -d de-drum && echo '→ http://localhost:7860'
